title: Razor scrape assay, an alternative variation to wound and healing assays
author: Lara-Reyes, Jimenez-Buendia, et al.
materials: Culture the cells to be used in the appropriate medium and supplementation until you have enough cells to do a passage. In the present method the human breast cancer cell line MCF-7 was routinely cultured in sterile 90 × 20 mm Petri dishes (46 cm2 growth area) (Corning), using RPMI-1640 culture medium without L-glutamine (LONZA) supplemented with non-inactivated FBS(Biowest) 8%%(v/v) and penicillin/streptomycin (Sigma/Aldrich) 1% (v/v) concentration. The cells were incubated using an incubator (Nuaire) maintained at 37°C and 5% CO2 atmosphere. The culture medium was changed every other day.

steps.title: Culture MCF‑7 cells
steps.instruction: Grow MCF‑7 cells in sterile 90 × 20 mm Petri dishes (46 cm²) using RPMI‑1640 without L‑glutamine (Lonza) supplemented with 8 % (v/v) non‑inactivated FBS (Biowest) and 1 % (v/v) penicillin/streptomycin (Sigma‑Aldrich); incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and change medium every other day until enough cells are available for a passage.

steps.title: Seed cells to confluence
steps.instruction: Plate the cells in 60 mm culture dishes (21 cm²) with the same medium and incubation conditions (37 °C, 5 % CO₂) and allow them to grow until the monolayer reaches >90 % confluence. Adjust seeding density and timing according to dish size.

steps.title: Mark starting line
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, press a sterile razor blade onto the cell monolayer on the plastic dish to create a straight line that will serve as the migration start point.

steps.title: Remove cells on one side
steps.instruction: Scrape away all cells on one side of the marked line using the same razor blade or a cell scraper, applying only gentle force to avoid damaging the dish surface.

substeps.instruction: Use the razor blade or scraper to sweep cells away.
Do not use excessive force; preserve the integrity of the plate.

steps.title: Aspirate medium and debris
steps.instruction: Aspirate the culture medium together with the detached cell debris from the dish.

steps.title: Wash three times with PBS
steps.instruction: Perform three washes by slowly adding phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) to the well walls until the surface is completely covered, then aspirate the PBS each time.

steps.title: Add test medium
steps.instruction: Slowly add fresh culture medium containing the test substance (and, if desired, low serum concentration) along the dish walls until the surface is fully covered, taking care not to detach additional cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare medium with the experimental compound.
Use low serum (e.g., ≤2 % FBS) to favor migration over proliferation.

steps.title: Select imaging areas
steps.instruction: Observe the dish under an inverted microscope, choose the regions to be photographed, and mark them for future imaging.

steps.title: Capture initial image
steps.instruction: Take a photograph of the marked areas (including the cell‑free zone) at the start of the assay.

steps.title: Incubate plate
steps.instruction: Place the culture plate back into the incubator set to 37 °C and 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Image at defined time points
steps.instruction: At each desired time interval, remove the plate from the incubator, place it under the inverted microscope, and photograph the previously marked areas to monitor cell migration.

substeps.instruction: Capture images of the marked fields.
